g.text: ALFA RADIO · COMPLETE HARDWARE SCHEMATIC & WIRING DIAGRAM
Raspberry Pi 3 (40-pin GPIO) interface to Waveshare 2.0" LCD, MAX98357A I²S Amp, ADS1115 ADC, Keypad & Resistor Divider
Halves 5V signal to 2.5V max for ADC
1. OS halts cleanly after 5 min inactivity.
2. Press side button to cut standby power.
3. Unplug bank from switch lead to charge.
